good_night.definition: What you say to somebody when you go to bed. It is a wish for a deep sleep.
good_night.example: I say good night to my grandmother every night.

how_are_you.definition: A friendly question you ask after saying hello, to start a small talk.
how_are_you.example: Good morning! How are you today?

intel_aptitude.definition: The capacity to learn a particular kind of work quickly and well.
intel_aptitude.example: She had an aptitude for the work: she was accurate within a week of arriving.

scent.definition: A smell that hangs in the air. Dogs can smell scents and follow them a long way.
scent.example: Pip knew the scent of his own garden.

security_screening.definition: The checkpoint where bags and people are checked before entering the secure part of the airport.
security_screening.example: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.

taboo.definition: A line that is not crossed at all, such as asking about somebody's salary.
taboo.example: Asking about his pay was a taboo, so I did not ask.
